# Data loading

```{r}
df <- read_excel("RiskData2.xlsx") %>%

df
```

# Long format

```{r}
df_uncertainty_long <- df_uncertainty %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bank = ifelse(grepl("^money_", variable), "Money Bank", "Time Bank"),
    variable_clean = gsub("^money_", "", variable),

    uncertainty = case_when(
      grepl("^mortality_", variable_clean) ~ "Mortality uncertainty",
      grepl("^aging_", variable_clean) ~ "Aging uncertainty",
      grepl("^policy_", variable_clean) ~ "Policy uncertainty",
      grepl("^economic_", variable_clean) ~ "Economic uncertainty",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    dimension = case_when(
      grepl("_clarity$", variable_clean) ~ "Clarity",
      grepl("_relevance$", variable_clean) ~ "Relevance",
      grepl("_worry$", variable_clean) ~ "Worry",
      grepl("_likelihood$", variable_clean) ~ "Likelihood",
      grepl("_control$", variable_clean) ~ "Control",
      grepl("_emotion_state$", variable_clean) ~ "Emotion State",
      grepl("_emotion_intensity$", variable_clean) ~ "Emotion Intensity",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(uncertainty), !is.na(dimension))

df_uncertainty_long
```

# Paired-samples t-tests

```{r}
df_wide <- df_uncertainty_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ID, uncertainty, dimension),
    names_from = bank,
    values_from = score
  ) %>%
  rename(time_score = `Time Bank`, money_score = `Money Bank`) %>%
  mutate(difference = time_score - money_score)

paired_results <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(dimension, uncertainty) %>%
  summarise(
    time_mean  = mean(time_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    money_mean = mean(money_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    time_sd    = sd(time_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    money_sd   = sd(money_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_mean  = mean(difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_sd    = sd(difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_se    = sd(difference, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    p_value = tryCatch(t.test(time_score, money_score, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
                       error = function(e) NA_real_),
    t_statistic = tryCatch(t.test(time_score, money_score, paired = TRUE)$statistic,
                           error = function(e) NA_real_),
    n_pairs = sum(!is.na(time_score) & !is.na(money_score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cohens_d = diff_mean / diff_sd,
    p_fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    sig_fdr = case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    p_fdr_formatted = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.4f", p_fdr))
  )

significant_fdr <- paired_results %>%
  filter(p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p_fdr) %>%
  dplyr::select(dimension, uncertainty, diff_mean, p_fdr, sig_fdr, cohens_d)

print("Paired-samples t-tests (FDR corrected) - significant results (p < .05):")
print(significant_fdr)
```

# Means and standard errors for plotting

```{r}
df_summary <- df_uncertainty_long %>%
  group_by(bank, uncertainty, dimension) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score   = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_score   = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

uncertainty_order <- c("Mortality uncertainty", "Aging uncertainty",
                       "Policy uncertainty", "Economic uncertainty")
df_summary$uncertainty <- factor(df_summary$uncertainty, levels = uncertainty_order)
paired_results$uncertainty <- factor(paired_results$uncertainty, levels = uncertainty_order)

uncertainty_numeric <- c("Mortality uncertainty" = 1,
                         "Aging uncertainty" = 2,
                         "Policy uncertainty" = 3,
                         "Economic uncertainty" = 4)

x_min <- min(df_summary$mean_score - df_summary$se_score, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.2
x_max <- max(df_summary$mean_score + df_summary$se_score, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.8
```

# Figure 1: Clarity (manipulation check)

```{r}
df_clarity <- df_summary %>% filter(dimension == "Clarity")

signif_clarity <- paired_results %>%
  filter(dimension == "Clarity", sig_fdr != "") %>%
  mutate(
    max_mean = pmax(time_mean, money_mean),
    x_pos = max_mean + 0.4,
    y_pos = uncertainty_numeric[as.character(uncertainty)]
  )

p_clarity <- ggplot(df_clarity, aes(x = mean_score, y = uncertainty, fill = bank)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = mean_score - se_score, xmax = mean_score + se_score),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Time Bank" = "#2E86AB", "Money Bank" = "#A23B72")) +
  geom_text(data = signif_clarity,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = sig_fdr),
            size = 6, color = "red", fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Clarity: Time Bank vs Money Bank",
       subtitle = "Red stars indicate significant differences (* p<.05, ** p<.01, *** p<.001, FDR corrected)",
       x = "Mean Score (± SE)", y = "Uncertainty Type", fill = "Bank Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max))

p_clarity
# ggsave("uncertainty_dimension_clarity.png", p_clarity, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Figure 2: Differences (Time Bank - Money Bank)

```{r}
dimensions_keep <- c("Likelihood", "Control", "Worry", "Emotion Intensity")

diff_data <- paired_results %>%
  filter(dimension %in% dimensions_keep) %>%
  mutate(uncertainty = factor(uncertainty,
                              levels = c("Policy uncertainty", "Economic uncertainty",
                                         "Mortality uncertainty", "Aging uncertainty")))

plot_dimension <- function(dim_name) {
  data_dim <- diff_data %>%
    filter(dimension == dim_name) %>%
    mutate(
      max_se = max(diff_se, na.rm = TRUE),
      offset = pmax(0.3, max_se * 0.8),
      star_y = diff_mean + diff_se + offset
    )

  ggplot(data_dim, aes(x = uncertainty, y = diff_mean)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2E86AB", width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = diff_mean - diff_se, ymax = diff_mean + diff_se),
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = star_y, label = sig_fdr),
              size = 5, color = "red", fontface = "bold", vjust = 0, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(title = dim_name, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
}

p_list <- lapply(dimensions_keep, plot_dimension)
names(p_list) <- dimensions_keep

combined_plot <- (p_list[["Likelihood"]] | p_list[["Control"]]) /
  (p_list[["Worry"]] | p_list[["Emotion Intensity"]]) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Uncertainty Perception Differences: Time Bank vs Money Bank",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"))
  ) &
  ylab("Difference (Time Bank - Money Bank) ± SE") &
  xlab("Uncertainty Type")

combined_plot
# ggsave("uncertainty_differences.png", combined_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# Save summary statistics

```{r}
summary_table <- paired_results %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dimension, uncertainty,
    time_mean, time_sd,
    money_mean, money_sd,
    diff_mean, diff_sd, diff_se,
    t_statistic, p_value, sig_fdr, cohens_d, n_pairs
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_mean = round(time_mean, 2),
    time_sd = round(time_sd, 2),
    money_mean = round(money_mean, 2),
    money_sd = round(money_sd, 2),
    diff_mean = round(diff_mean, 3),
    diff_sd = round(diff_sd, 3),
    diff_se = round(diff_se, 3),
    t_statistic = round(t_statistic, 3),
    p_value = round(p_value, 4),
    cohens_d = round(cohens_d, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(dimension, p_value)

print("Paired-samples t-test summary:")
print(summary_table)

write.csv(summary_table, "uncertainty_comparison_paired_ttest.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Manipulation check: one-sample t-tests

```{r}
ttest_table <- df_uncertainty_long %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark = if_else(grepl("Emotion State", dimension, ignore.case = TRUE), 5, 4)
  ) %>%
  group_by(bank, uncertainty, dimension, benchmark) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    x <- .x$score
    mu <- unique(.y$benchmark)
    tt <- t.test(x, mu = mu)
    m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble(
      n = sum(!is.na(x)),
      mean = m,
      sd = s,
      mean_diff = m - mu,
      t = unname(tt$statistic),
      df = unname(tt$parameter),
      p = tt$p.value,
      cohens_d = ifelse(is.na(s) || s == 0, NA_real_, (m - mu) / s)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(bank, uncertainty, dimension)

ttest_table

write.csv(ttest_table, "one_sample_t_test_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Clarity repeated-measures ANOVA

```{r}
clarity_wide <- df_uncertainty_long %>%
  filter(dimension == "Clarity") %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, bank, uncertainty, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ID, uncertainty),
    names_from = bank,
    values_from = score
  ) %>%
  rename(Time_Bank = `Time Bank`, Money_Bank = `Money Bank`)

clarity_long <- clarity_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Time_Bank, Money_Bank),
    names_to = "bank",
    values_to = "clarity_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bank = factor(bank, levels = c("Time_Bank", "Money_Bank")),
    uncertainty = factor(uncertainty,
                         levels = c("Mortality uncertainty", "Aging uncertainty",
                                    "Policy uncertainty", "Economic uncertainty")),
    ID = factor(ID)
  )

res_aov <- aov(clarity_score ~ bank * uncertainty + Error(ID / (bank * uncertainty)),
               data = clarity_long)
summary(res_aov)
```
